## History

Jerry Corcoran offered [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) a political bribe, which was accidentally witnessed by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). The encounter caused Judson to capitulate to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Improvement Society's request regarding his fences so that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) would keep quiet and not ruin Judson's reputation.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066)_
